lines.zh: 四蹄踩过热带草原，草先低头。
lines.en: Four hooves cross the savanna, and the grass bows first.

lines.zh: 我这具身子重，走一步地面应一声。
lines.en: This body is heavy; the ground answers every single step.

lines.zh: 沥青坑边我绕开，陷进去没人拉得动。
lines.en: I skirt the tar pits; once sunk, nothing could pull me out.

lines.zh: 高林的树影落在我背上，像第二层皮。
lines.en: High-forest shadows fall on my back like a second hide.

lines.zh: 我们两三头并排走，路自然就宽了。
lines.en: Two or three of us walk abreast, and the path widens itself.

lines.zh: 平原上没有谁挡我，我也不急着赶谁。
lines.en: Nothing blocks me on the plains, and I hurry no one.

lines.zh: 角先动，腿才跟上，这是我的走法。
lines.en: Horns move first, legs follow; that is how I walk.

lines.zh: 蹄子踏出闷响，像远处有人在敲鼓。
lines.en: My hooves drum a dull note, like distant hands on a drum.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可这段路总会走完。
lines.en: I am not fast, but every road ends eventually.

lines.zh: 草籽粘在腹毛上，一路跟着我回家。
lines.en: Grass seeds cling to my belly fur and ride me home.

lines.zh: 身后两头小牛跟着，我放慢了半步。
lines.en: Two calves trail behind me, so I slow by half a step.

lines.zh: 这地方草厚，踩下去能没过蹄子。
lines.en: The grass here is deep enough to swallow my hooves.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把一声长吟送进土里。
lines.en: I lower my head and pour a long low into the soil.

lines.zh: 沉吟不是说话，是我这副嗓子的动静。
lines.en: The humming is not speech; it is simply how my throat works.

lines.zh: 站定的时候，我听见自己心口在响。
lines.en: Standing still, I hear my own chest working.

lines.zh: 二十九颗心的份量，压得草窝发塌。
lines.en: Twenty-nine hearts of weight flatten the grass beneath me.

lines.zh: 风穿过角尖，吹出一点空空的声音。
lines.en: Wind threads my horn tips and makes a hollow little sound.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草，嚼得很慢，反正时间够。
lines.en: I chew slowly; there is more than enough time.

lines.zh: 苍蝇绕着我的背转，我懒得甩尾。
lines.en: Flies circle my back, and I cannot be bothered to swat.

lines.zh: 这么大体型，站着就是这片地的风景。
lines.en: At this size, standing still is scenery.

lines.zh: 我把鼻息喷在地上，尘土浮起来。
lines.en: I snort into the dirt and the dust lifts.

lines.zh: 远处有动静，我耳朵先动，身子不动。
lines.en: Something stirs far off; my ears move, my body does not.

lines.zh: 沥青味从坡下飘上来，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Tar smell drifts up the slope, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我数着同伴的呼吸，一、二、三。
lines.en: I count my herdmates' breathing: one, two, three.

lines.zh: 影子缩短了，太阳爬到了我背上。
lines.en: My shadow shortens; the sun has climbed onto my back.

lines.zh: 我不惹事，但也不打算让路。
lines.en: I start no trouble, but I do not plan to step aside.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，我抬高了下巴看你。
lines.en: You stand too close; I lift my chin to look at you.

lines.zh: 你手里没有草，那就不算招呼。
lines.en: There is no grass in your hands, so this is no greeting.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，角尖不自觉对着你。
lines.en: I stare, and my horn tips drift toward you on their own.

lines.zh: 你这身板，在我眼里算轻的。
lines.en: By my measure, your frame counts as light.

lines.zh: 你也听见那声低吟了吧，那是我。
lines.en: You heard that low note too; that was me.

lines.zh: 我不是凶，只是不喜欢被摸。
lines.en: I am not vicious, I simply dislike being touched.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我的脖子就松一分。
lines.en: Step back half a pace and my neck eases by a fraction.

lines.zh: 我眨一次眼要很久，你等得起吗。
lines.en: My blink takes a long time; can you wait?

lines.zh: 你闻起来像铁，不像这片草原。
lines.en: You smell of iron, not of this grassland.

lines.zh: 我看着你，想知道你敢不敢再近。
lines.en: I watch you, wondering whether you dare come closer.

lines.zh: 高林的雾里，你只是一团影子。
lines.en: In the high-forest mist you are only a shape.

lines.zh: 你把背对着我，我记下了这件事。
lines.en: You turned your back on me, and I noted it.

lines.zh: 我闷叫一声，把这股疼咽回去。
lines.en: I grunt once and swallow the pain back down.

lines.zh: 疼得我偏了半步，蹄子陷进土里。
lines.en: Pain shifts me half a step, hooves sinking into soil.

lines.zh: 谁在打我，我可记仇。
lines.en: Whoever is hitting me, I do hold grudges.

lines.zh: 皮厚也有用尽的时候。
lines.en: Even thick hide runs out of use.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，血从角根往下淌。
lines.en: I shake my head, and blood runs from the horn roots.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起沥青坑的味道。
lines.en: This blow brings back the smell of the tar pits.

lines.zh: 我不常发火，你正在让我发火。
lines.en: I rarely get angry; you are making me angry.

lines.zh: 野牛一样的身子晃了晃，没倒。
lines.en: My bison-like bulk sways, but does not fall.

lines.zh: 我喘得像风箱，声音传到坡下。
lines.en: I wheeze like a bellows, loud enough for the lower slope.

lines.zh: 再打，我就把这副身子全用上。
lines.en: Hit me again and I will use all of this body.

lines.zh: 这草闻着甜，我鼻子先替你答应了。
lines.en: The grass smells sweet; my nose agrees before I do.

lines.zh: 你把草举高，我低着头也得凑过去。
lines.en: You hold it high, and I must stoop toward it anyway.

lines.zh: 我不追人，但我追一把嫩草。
lines.en: I chase no one, but I will chase a handful of young grass.

lines.zh: 手心里的草，比地上那层香些。
lines.en: Grass in a palm smells better than the carpet below.

lines.zh: 我挪一步，又挪一步，是草在拉我。
lines.en: One step, then another; the grass is doing the pulling.

lines.zh: 你晃那束草，我的舌头已经动了。
lines.en: You wave the bundle, and my tongue has already moved.

lines.zh: 这味道像高林雨后的第一茬。
lines.en: This tastes of the first growth after rain in the high forest.

lines.zh: 我这么大个，被一把草牵着走。
lines.en: Something my size, led along by one fistful of grass.

lines.zh: 别急，我嘴大，会连你的手一起碰。
lines.en: Careful: my mouth is wide and will include your hand.

lines.zh: 草没了，我才想起自己站得多近。
lines.en: The grass is gone, and only then do I notice the distance.

lines.zh: 你撞上来了，我几乎没晃。
lines.en: You ran into me, and I barely swayed.

lines.zh: 我这身肉不是墙，可比墙软不了多少。
lines.en: This flesh is not a wall, but it gives about as much.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，蹄子不长眼睛。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; hooves have no eyes.

lines.zh: 你退开吧，我不想为这个转身。
lines.en: Back off; I will not turn around for this.

lines.zh: 我擦了擦肩，你该庆幸只是擦到。
lines.en: I brushed your shoulder; be glad it was only a brush.

lines.zh: 骨头顶骨头，你吃亏是必然的。
lines.en: Bone against bone, and your loss is arithmetic.

lines.zh: 我已经让了半步，剩下的你自己让。
lines.en: I gave half a step; give the rest yourself.

lines.zh: 这坡度上，我停不住太急。
lines.en: On this slope I cannot stop quickly.

lines.zh: 你把我惹烦了，我才会真的低头。
lines.en: Annoy me enough and I will actually lower my head.

lines.zh: 角根发麻，刚才那下不轻。
lines.en: My horn roots are numb; that blow was not light.

lines.zh: 我低吟一声，林子那头就有回音。
lines.en: I low once, and the far treeline answers.

lines.zh: 她来了，草被两副身子压平了。
lines.en: She arrives, and two bodies flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 这季节，我连走路都放轻。
lines.en: This season I even walk more softly.

lines.zh: 我们头抵着头，谁也没用力。
lines.en: Head to head, neither of us leaning in.

lines.zh: 小牛会跟着她，我负责看四周。
lines.en: The calves will follow her; I will watch the surroundings.

lines.zh: 我的角不为了打，可这时候得亮出来。
lines.en: My horns are not for fighting, but now they must show.

lines.zh: 她闻我肩上的草籽，我站着不动。
lines.en: She sniffs the seeds on my shoulder; I hold still.

lines.zh: 两三头一起，日子才不算长。
lines.en: Two or three together, and the days stop feeling long.

lines.zh: 这声长吟是给她听的，不是给你。
lines.en: This long call is for her, not for you.

lines.zh: 完事了，我们各自低头吃草。
lines.en: When it is done, we each lower our heads to graze.

lines.zh: 有东西挂在我角上，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Something is snagged on my horn, and I cannot shake it.

lines.zh: 我低头时捡起了什么，也不认得。
lines.en: I pick something up while grazing and cannot name it.

lines.zh: 蹄缝里卡着块亮石头，先带着走。
lines.en: A bright stone is wedged in my hoof; I will carry it.

lines.zh: 我不捡东西，可东西总往我身上沾。
lines.en: I collect nothing, yet things keep sticking to me.

lines.zh: 这块东西不香，我咬了一下就吐了。
lines.en: This does not smell like food; I bite, then spit.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里，走了一路才放下。
lines.en: I carry it in my mouth a whole path before dropping it.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西在泥里，我用鼻子拱出来。
lines.en: Your dropped thing is in the mud; my nose digs it out.

lines.zh: 我背上落了根树枝，就那么背着。
lines.en: A branch landed on my back, and there it stays.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿太轻，我含着像没含。
lines.en: It is so light I forget it is in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把草料推成一堆。
lines.en: I nudge the fodder into a pile with my snout.

lines.zh: 我从草里抬起眼，先看见你的鞋。
lines.en: I raise my eyes from the grass and see your boots first.

lines.zh: 有谁进了我的草场，我记住了位置。
lines.en: Someone entered my pasture, and I marked the spot.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一皱，闻出这不是同类的味。
lines.en: My nose wrinkles: this is no herdmate's scent.

lines.zh: 我低头，犄角对准你的胸口。
lines.en: I lower my head, horns level with your chest.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，不是要追，是要看清。
lines.en: I turn slowly, not to chase but to see clearly.

lines.zh: 角先偏过去，然后整颗头才跟上。
lines.en: The horns swing first, then the whole head follows.

lines.zh: 这头牛盯上了你，你得知道分寸。
lines.en: This bull has noticed you; mind your distance.

lines.zh: 我低吟一声，算是给你个提醒。
lines.en: I let out one low note, which is your warning.

lines.zh: 你站在下风口，可我鼻子更好使。
lines.en: You stand downwind, but my nose works better than that.

lines.zh: 草地安静下来，是因为我停了咀嚼。
lines.en: The field goes quiet because I stopped chewing.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢背后有脚步声。
lines.en: I dislike footsteps behind me.

lines.zh: 高林的树把我遮住，你还以为没人。
lines.en: The trees hide me, and you think the forest is empty.

lines.zh: 我把蹄子挪正，正对着你的方向。
lines.en: I set my hooves square, pointed at where you stand.

lines.zh: 目标这个词太凶，我只是看着你。
lines.en: Target is too fierce a word; I am only looking.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有尾巴在打拍子。
lines.en: I hold still; only my tail keeps time.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，我的角尖就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, my horn tips follow.

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要过去。
lines.en: I have not decided whether to come over.

lines.zh: 这本该是吃草的时辰，你打断了。
lines.en: This was grazing hour, and you interrupted it.

lines.zh: 我鼻息变粗了，你听见没有。
lines.en: My breathing has deepened; did you hear it?

lines.zh: 你手里那东西反光，我一直看着。
lines.en: That thing in your hand glints, and I keep watching.

lines.zh: 我踩了踩地，试着估你的距离。
lines.en: I stamp the ground, testing the distance to you.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来我这身子也想动。
lines.en: Do not run; if you run, this body wants to move too.

lines.zh: 我们隔着十步，谁都没先低头。
lines.en: Ten paces apart, and neither of us lowers first.

lines.zh: 我的耐心和我的体重一样厚。
lines.en: My patience is as thick as my weight.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我脖子上的毛立起来了。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and the hair on my neck rises.

lines.zh: 这片草场今天归我看守。
lines.en: This pasture is under my watch today.

lines.zh: 我只要低头就能撞到你，你知道的。
lines.en: One lowered head reaches you; you know that.

lines.zh: 你退，我就当没发生过。
lines.en: You retreat, and I will pretend it never happened.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，角就正对着你。
lines.en: I lower my head so the horns point at you.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，角先到，你后到。
lines.en: I drop my head; the horns arrive before you do.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，是我收着的。
lines.en: That was not heavy; I was holding back.

lines.zh: 你被顶飞了，草地接住了你。
lines.en: You flew, and the grass caught you.

lines.zh: 我只撞一下，撞完就往后退。
lines.en: I strike once, then step back.

lines.zh: 蹄子跟着踏下去，那是我在警告。
lines.en: The hooves stamp after, and that is the warning.

lines.zh: 我的角划过空气，声音比伤重。
lines.en: My horns cut air; the sound hurts more than the blow.

lines.zh: 你打疼我了，我才回这一下。
lines.en: You hurt me, so you earned this one.

lines.zh: 这一顶我只用了半个身子。
lines.en: That charge used only half of me.

lines.zh: 你摔在泥里，我不追，也不笑。
lines.en: You land in mud; I neither chase nor laugh.

lines.zh: 别站起来又冲，我还会再来一次。
lines.en: Do not get up and charge again; I will repeat myself.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你从身边扫开。
lines.en: I swing my head and sweep you off my flank.

lines.zh: 我这副身板撞上来，会留印子。
lines.en: When this bulk hits, it leaves marks.

lines.zh: 打完我就喘，比你还累。
lines.en: After the hit I pant harder than you.

lines.zh: 够了，都退开，草还要吃。
lines.en: Enough; everyone back off, there is grass to eat.

lines.zh: 草叶分开，我们两三头一起落地。
lines.en: The grass parts, and two or three of us settle in.

lines.zh: 传说维度的早晨，先有我这一声。
lines.en: In a Precasia morning, my low comes first.

lines.zh: 高林的雾还没散，我已经站在里面。
lines.en: The high-forest mist has not lifted, and I am already in it.

lines.zh: 这地方草厚水足，我们就留在这。
lines.en: Deep grass and good water; we will stay here.

lines.zh: 我从沥青坑边走上来，蹄上还粘着黑。
lines.en: I climb up from the tar pits with black still on my hooves.

lines.zh: 平原上新来的两头，跟着我走。
lines.en: Two newcomers on the plain fall in behind me.

lines.zh: 这里没有谁欢迎我，也不需要。
lines.en: No one welcomes me here, and none is needed.

lines.zh: 我一落地，附近的鸟都换了树。
lines.en: The moment I land, nearby birds change trees.

lines.zh: 我们四头分开站，各看一个方向。
lines.en: Four of us stand apart, each watching a direction.

lines.zh: 生成在这片热带草原，我就吃这片草。
lines.en: Spawned in this savanna, I eat this savanna's grass.

lines.zh: 泥土被我踩实，一小块空地成形了。
lines.en: Packed earth under me, and a small clearing appears.

lines.zh: 我的低吟在坡上滚了两圈才散。
lines.en: My low rolls twice down the slope before fading.

lines.zh: 这么重的身子，落下来先扬一片土。
lines.en: A body this heavy lands with a cloud of dust.

lines.zh: 你不用找我，我会走过来的。
lines.en: You need not find me; I will walk over.

lines.zh: 沥青坑边，我们四头一起站起来。
lines.en: By the tar pits, four of us rise at once.

lines.zh: 我踩碎一层枯草，落在这片坡上。
lines.en: I crush a layer of dry grass, landing on this slope.

lines.zh: 火烧到我厚皮上，焦味很冲。
lines.en: Fire bites my thick hide, and the scorched smell is strong.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下来，腿不答应。
lines.en: Falling from that height, my legs do not agree.

lines.zh: 我鼻子进了水，拼命往岸上顶。
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I shove hard for shore.

lines.zh: 那声响把我震得一屁股坐下。
lines.en: The blast sits me down hard on my rear.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我肩膀，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something is stuck in my shoulder and will not pull free.

lines.zh: 这东西烫得不像是火，我甩不掉。
lines.en: This burns unlike fire, and shaking will not shed it.

lines.zh: 草被我吃空了，肚子还空着。
lines.en: I have eaten the grass bare and am still empty.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我角上，眼前全白。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horns and my sight goes white.

lines.zh: 脚下没了地，这身重也没用。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and all this weight is useless.
